purpose: Provision and prove recovery of the empty production database-vault before any production PostgreSQL cutover.

header_custody_executor.execution_boundary: existing backup-worker container with private R2 credential mount

docker_restart_gate.control: Docker ExecStartPre checks the database mapper, ext4 label, mount options and pgdata subpath before daemon start.
docker_restart_gate.installation_gate: Only after PostgreSQL production cutover has succeeded and legacy rollback remains retained.
docker_restart_gate.missing_mapper_behavior: docker.service fails closed before daemon start once this gate is installed

production_gate_order: FR-06C2A protected source and isolated lab are merged
FR-06C2B protected PR head and exact post-merge main pass
fresh encrypted R2 backup and independent restore validation pass within 3600 seconds
active and recovery database-vault key bundles exist as distinct external custody items
owner authorization and bounded maintenance window are current
empty database-vault plan and apply succeed without stopping PostgreSQL or any client
LUKS2 header is uploaded off-host and fully read-back verified
recovery key opens the empty vault and active key reopens it
tmpfs key inputs and local header staging copy are removed
production PGDATA cutover remains separately blocked until FR-06C2C

failure_policy.before_success_receipt: Remove only database-vault artifacts created by the failed invocation.
failure_policy.after_success_receipt: Retain encrypted candidate and evidence; do not delete legacy PGDATA or install the Docker gate yet.
